description:
Saju DoctorFortune (사주팔자 운세박사) brings the ancient Korean art of Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) to ChatGPT, powered by proprietary AI trained with over 20 master fortune tellers from Seoul's most prestigious districts.

Simply share your birth date, time, and gender, and instantly receive a professionally analyzed birth chart — including your Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements distribution, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual Fortune forecasts (세운), all visualized in a clean, interactive card.

Trusted by over 1 million monthly users, Saju DoctorFortune is the world's leading AI-powered Saju service. Every reading is grounded in authentic Myeongrihak (명리학) principles, delivering the same depth and accuracy you'd expect from a top-tier in-person consultation — but available anytime, right inside your conversation.

Whether you're curious about career timing, relationship compatibility, or what the year ahead holds, ask ChatGPT with Saju DoctorFortune and get clear, honest insights rooted in centuries of Korean fortune-telling tradition.
